title: CODATA 2022: one unified atomic mass unit is 931.494 103 72 MeV
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 29 MeV. This is the energy equivalent of the atomic mass constant.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'atomic mass constant energy equivalent in MeV 931.494 103 72' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 29' MeV. A round '931.5 MeV' is a rounding of this line, not the line itself.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
